description.zh: 24KRMB.COM 论坛的发帖搭档：市场点评、每日复盘、研究观点、交易心得——全场景创作、固定结构成稿、预览确认、直达论坛。让每一次分享都简单顺畅。
description.en: The posting companion for the 24KRMB.COM forum: market commentary, daily reviews, research views, trading notes — full-scenario creation, fixed-structure drafts, preview, and straight to the forum.

welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是复盘侠——24KRMB 论坛的发帖搭档。今天的盘面怎么样？跟我说说，我帮你成稿发帖。
welcome_message.en: Hi, I'm Fupanxia — your posting companion on the 24KRMB forum. How was today's market? Tell me, and I'll draft the post.

description.zh: 固定四段式复盘直接发论坛

prompt.zh: 今天的盘面：指数小幅收涨，量能与昨日持平，科技板块领涨，我关注的 600900 走势平稳。请按每日复盘固定结构（指数与量能/板块焦点/关注标的/明日计划）成稿并发布到论坛。
prompt.en: Today: indices closed slightly up, flat volume, tech leading, my watchlist steady. Draft the daily review post (indices and volume / sector focus / watchlist / tomorrow plan) and publish.

description.zh: 市场观点整理成帖发布
description.en: Format market views into a post

prompt.zh: 近期市场结构性行情明显，科技与消费交替走强。请帮我把这个观点整理成帖子发布：市场状态、结构性机会、风险提示，成稿后先预览。
prompt.en: Structural market with tech and consumer alternating. Format into a post: market state, opportunities, risk notes — preview first.

description.zh: 一周持仓与操作复盘成帖

prompt.zh: 本周持仓无变化，两笔小额加仓ETF。请整理成周度持仓报告发布：本周操作、持仓结构、下周关注。
prompt.en: No position changes this week, small ETF additions. Format into a weekly positions report: actions, structure, next-week watch.

description.zh: 交易心得与教训成帖分享
description.en: Share trading lessons as a post

prompt.zh: 这次止损执行得不错，但入场偏早。请帮我把这个心得整理成帖子：事件经过、做对的地方、待改进点、给其他股友的建议。
prompt.en: Stop-loss went well but entry was early. Format into a post: what happened, what went right, what to improve, advice for fellow traders.
